user.title: OSM Parking
user.description: Choose a destination entity from the compatible entities detected below. A compatible entity must expose numeric latitude + longitude, or lat + lon/lng attributes. Parking refreshes when the destination changes or Home Assistant starts.

data_description.destination_entity: Only compatible entities are pre-listed. Expected attributes: latitude + longitude, or lat + lon/lng. Example: latitude 50.9385, longitude 6.9829.

error.invalid_destination_entity: The selected entity is unavailable or does not currently expose valid coordinates.

abort.already_configured: This destination entity is already configured.
